name: fo-company-registration-reporting
description: Prepare incorporation, ownership and annual-filing working papers for ordinary Faroese P/F and Sp/F companies in 2026. Covers subscribed and paid capital, founders and formation documents, registration timing, shareholder records, significant legal owners and beneficial ownership, management and capital-loss duties, the new annual-accounts framework for financial years beginning in 2026, audit and reporting size tests, separate Registrar and company-tax deadlines, late-filing consequences and bookkeeping retention. Use for Faroe Islands company formation, minimum capital, owner registration, annual accounts, audit exemption and company compliance calendar questions. It produces a documented checklist for qualified local review. Foreign branches, special entities, licences and unresolved first-year or holding-company audit implementation require their own source work.
